subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2766
title: Removes the provision stating that a justice court may not become a court of record if the court is located within 50 driving miles of the circuit court for the county in which the justice court is located.
headline: HB 2766 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2766 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2766 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
